name: tribal_tech
what: Tribal tech production for Hello Toni's second song (2026-11-02), the person's ask: no noise risers, no air sweeps, no filter sweeps. The record's own material makes the transitions: a beat of silence before each drop, a reverb throw on the last words, a tom roll rising a fifth through the build, the chops stuttered for the last bar, a tape stop into the break, a sub drop under the drop's first kick (the plan's fx_cues). A music bus and a drum bus, the house chains by role, a medium pump on the music bus and a full one on the sub.
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x} from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
